Fact.Name: Schedule A (Form 8936) f3_6[0]: line 22, the line 21 basis multiplied by the credit rate
Fact.Description: What amount is on line 22 of this vehicle's Schedule A (Form 8936)? Help: line 22 is the line 21 basis (cost or other basis less any section 179 deduction) multiplied by 15% when line 18d is Yes (the vehicle is also powered by a gasoline or diesel engine), or by 30% when line 18d is No (Schedule A line 22, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f8936sa.pdf, page 3; Instructions for Form 8936, https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i8936.pdf, pages 4, 7). Asked for a vehicle whose copy completes Part V, the qualified commercial clean vehicle credit. Unanswered: the line 22 box prints blank; no computation reads this box, and the Form 8936 line 19 amount comes from this vehicle's line 26. Validation: a dollar amount in integer cents, not less than $0.00. Feeds: the printed Schedule A line 22; line 24 is the smaller of line 22 and line 23.

Fact.Name: Schedule A (Form 8936) vehicle copy fully transcribed
Fact.Description: Have you recorded every field that applies on this vehicle's completed Schedule A (Form 8936), including the applicable line 11, 12, 17, and 26 amounts? Answer Yes only when this vehicle's copy is fully transcribed; enter $0.00 for any applicable total line with no credit. An unanswered or No answer keeps this vehicle's credit out of the return by making the Form 8936 roll-up Incomplete.

Fact.Name: This vehicle's Schedule A transcription is attested complete
Fact.Description: The item-level Yes/No attestation read by the all-vehicles completion guard. It intentionally remains Incomplete until the filer answers, and returns false when the filer answers No.

Fact.Name: This vehicle copy carries at least one answered printed box
Fact.Description: True when the filer has answered at least one of this vehicle copy's 63 printed Schedule A (Form 8936) boxes. The print selection reads it, so an item carrying no printed entry is a placeholder and does not produce a blank Schedule A copy. The transcription attestation is deliberately not one of the boxes tested: it is not a printed field, and an attested but otherwise empty item is exactly the placeholder this fact exists to exclude.

Fact.Name: All entered Schedule A (Form 8936) vehicle copies are attested complete
Fact.Description: True only when every vehicle item has an answered Yes attestation that its applicable Schedule A boxes were transcribed. An empty, answered collection is false here and is handled by the no-vehicle compatibility arm; an unanswered collection stays Incomplete.

Fact.Name: Schedule A (Form 8936) vehicle copies to print
Fact.Description: The submitted Schedule A vehicle items that contain at least one answered printed box. The form is included once for each selected item. A seeded empty collection yields no copies and a bare return does not print a blank Schedule A.
